title: cymopterus terebinthinus var. calcareus
intro: Cymopterus terebinthinus var. calcareus, commonly known as calcareous desert parsley, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a perennial herb native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting against cell damage. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal effects.
